# <span id="aanchor519"></span> Rollup Configuration

Use the System Rollup Configuration screen to specify system-level default settings that are related to rollup calculations and services.

<div class="procedure">

To access the System Rollup Configuration screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the **System** group, select **Rollup Configuration**.
    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 558;height: 419;" />  

</div>

The following options are available:

- **For Location Reports Print** - Select the information to include in the heading for location-based reports.

- **Pressure Printing Option** - Select the pressure value to include in reports.

- **Volume, Energy** - For gas only, specify the default number of decimals on the rollup viewers and Standard Reports screen.

- **Gas Avg.** - Select the averaging technique to use for the displayed values. The default technique is **Flow Weighted, Linear**, but you can choose to use **Time Weighted, Linear**.

- **Gas Rounding** - Select the carry/borrow method to use when rolling up periodic values to hourly, daily, and monthly totals.

  If you select **Daily**, FLOWCAL rounds up or down the daily total and then totals integer days for the month.

  If you select **Monthly**, FLOWCAL applies the carry/borrow functionality throughout the month.

- **Liq. Avg.** - Select the averaging technique to use for liquids.

- **Balance Arithmetic** - Select the numerator and denominator for balance calculations.

- **Activity Codes** - Select the activities that you want to include in reports that are related to periodic meter data. Available activity codes are:
  - 01 – Events
  - 02 – Alarms
  - 03 – Characteristic Change
  - 04 – Analysis Change
  - 05 – Edited Data
  - 06 – Estimated Data
  - 07 – Inactive Meter
  - 08 – New Meter
  - 09 – Meter Re-Connect
  - 10 – Meter Calibration
  - 11 – Trouble Ticket
  - 12 – Calculated Meter
  - 13 – Check Meter Exists

- **Reports** - Select the company logo to use in reports.

  Dimensions for the large logo are 0.75"h x 3"w (72 pixels x 288 pixels). Dimensions for the small logo are 0.38"h x 1.5"w (36 pixels x 144 pixels). Preferred image file formats are JPG, PNG, and BMP.
